questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code decides whether a rider falls inside a percentage rollout? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A new flag is stored as {"key": "match-by-acceptance", "enabled": true, "cities": ["SEA"]} with no percent. Which riders get the new ranking?
choices: All riders in every city, because enabled is true
Half of the riders in SEA
All riders in SEA and nobody elsewhere

questions.prompt: An operator pushes a config in which one rule has percent=140. What happens to the flags already being served?
choices: load_rules raises before swap is called, so the evaluator keeps serving its existing rules
The bad rule is clamped to 100 and the rest of the config is applied
All flags are disabled until a valid config is pushed
The bad rule is skipped and the other rules are applied

questions.prompt: A rule has enabled=true, percent=100 and kill=true. What does is_on return?
choices: True only for cities listed in the rule
False for everyone, because kill short-circuits before any other check
It depends on the rider's hash bucket
